🧠 NY SESSION SMC FOREX MAP — EURUSD + GBPUSD

Fresh market data | Daily → 4H → 1H → 15M
Session: New York
No setup is an entry until 15M confirmation occurs.

🔥 STRONGEST SETUP — GBPUSD BUY
Current: ~$1.3226

HTF READ
• Daily has been recovering from the ~1.319 area after a broader pullback.
• 4H structure has shifted into a bullish recovery, with price holding above the 1.3215 area.
• 1H liquidity sits above around 1.3231 and 1.3240.
• Recent 15M price action swept the ~1.3216 area and displaced higher toward 1.3231.

🎯 PRIMARY LONG
Wait for a pullback into 1.3220–1.3224, then require bullish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 1.3231
→ 1.3240
→ 1.3250

Invalidation: sustained loss of ~1.3214.

R:R to the main 1H liquidity target is approximately 1:3 if the entry is taken near the middle of the zone.

🟠 EURUSD SELL — CONDITIONAL
Current: ~$1.1204

HTF READ
• Daily and 4H structure remain bearish despite the current corrective rebound.
• The euro remains under pressure from ongoing European fiscal/political concerns, while the dollar remains broadly firm.
• 1H buy-side liquidity is concentrated around 1.1216–1.1222.
• The preferred trade is NOT to chase the current price lower.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retracement into 1.1214–1.1219, then require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 1.1196
→ 1.1187
→ 1.1162

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~1.1225.

⚠️ SESSION VERDICT
GBPUSD is the cleaner technical setup because its nearest meaningful 1H liquidity target offers better R:R.
EURUSD has the stronger macro bearish backdrop, but requires the retracement + 15M confirmation before becoming actionable.

No USDJPY/GBPJPY setup is being forced into this run because the Twelve Data feed hit its per-minute API credit limit while expanding the scan. I will not substitute stale or guessed data.

Educational market analysis — not financial advice.
